// Generate public ML-DSA-87 test data using Go's independent implementation.
// Run as generate.go. The seed and message are synthetic.
package main

import (
	"crypto/mldsa"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	seed := make([]byte, 32)
	for i := range seed {
		seed[i] = byte(i)
	}
	key, err := mldsa.NewPrivateKey(mldsa.MLDSA87(), seed)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	message := []byte("Witchy ML-DSA-87 verification fixture\n")
	signature, err := key.SignDeterministic(message, &mldsa.Options{})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	vector := append([]byte{}, key.PublicKey().Bytes()...)
	vector = append(vector, message...)
	vector = append(vector, signature...)
	if err := os.WriteFile("vector.bin", vector, 0644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
